name: tripwise-monorepo
description: TripWise — Smart Travel Planner | Full-Stack Web Development Recruitment Submission for AWS Student Builder Group, VIT Chennai

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:relevance && npm run test:backend
